theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiDens_lipschitz_gaussGreen
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U G : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet G volume → IsGaussGreenPair U G μ ν → ∀ (ζ : Rn N → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∀ w : Rn N, ∫ y in G ∩ U, fderiv ℝ ζ y w = -∫ y, ζ y * inner ℝ w (ν y) ∂μ
